/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

// Exports the contents of a grid (using the selected order and filters) to an Excel file.
LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)

Do 'OpenDocument'

&CellRow = 1
&FirstColumn = 1

Do 'LoadGridState'

Do 'WriteFilters'

Do 'WriteColumnTitles'

Do 'WriteData'

Do 'CloseDocument'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


Sub 'OpenDocument'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&Random = Random() * 10000
	&Filename = !"listarProductosExport-" + &Random.ToString().Trim() + !".xlsx"

	&ExcelDocument.Open(&Filename)
	Do 'CheckStatus'
	&ExcelDocument.Clear()

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'WriteFilters'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	If not (&FilterFullText.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "WWP_FullTextFilterDescription")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&FilterFullText)
	EndIf
	If not (&TFProductoCategoriaNombre_Sel.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Categoría")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFProductoCategoriaNombre_Sel)
	Else
		If not (&TFProductoCategoriaNombre.IsEmpty())
			WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Categoría")
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFProductoCategoriaNombre)
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not (&TFProductoBaseProductoClave_Sel.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Producto Base")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFProductoBaseProductoClave_Sel)
	Else
		If not (&TFProductoBaseProductoClave.IsEmpty())
			WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Producto Base")
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFProductoBaseProductoClave)
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not (&TFProductoClave_Sel.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Clave")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFProductoClave_Sel)
	Else
		If not (&TFProductoClave.IsEmpty())
			WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Clave")
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFProductoClave)
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not (&TFProductoNombre_Sel.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Nombre")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFProductoNombre_Sel)
	Else
		If not (&TFProductoNombre.IsEmpty())
			WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Nombre")
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFProductoNombre)
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not (&TFProductoDescripcion_Sel.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Descripcion")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFProductoDescripcion_Sel)
	Else
		If not (&TFProductoDescripcion.IsEmpty())
			WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Descripcion")
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFProductoDescripcion)
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not (&TFProductoPrecioUnitario.IsEmpty() AND &TFProductoPrecioUnitario_To.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Precio Unitario")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Number = &TFProductoPrecioUnitario
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, false, &CellRow, &FirstColumn + 2, "WWP_TSTo")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 3).Number = &TFProductoPrecioUnitario_To
	EndIf
	If not (&TFProductoInventarioActual.IsEmpty() AND &TFProductoInventarioActual_To.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Inventario Actual")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Number = &TFProductoInventarioActual
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, false, &CellRow, &FirstColumn + 2, "WWP_TSTo")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 3).Number = &TFProductoInventarioActual_To
	EndIf
	If not (&TFProductoTipoMaterial_Sels.Count = 0)
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Tipo Material")
		&i = 1
		For &TFProductoTipoMaterial_Sel in &TFProductoTipoMaterial_Sels
			If &i = 1
				&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = ''
			Else
				&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text += ', '
			EndIf
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text += &TFProductoTipoMaterial_Sel.EnumerationDescription()
			&i += 1
		EndFor
	EndIf
	If not (&TFProductoActivo_Sel.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Activo")
		Do Case
			Case &TFProductoActivo_Sel = 1
				&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = "WWP_TSChecked"
			Case &TFProductoActivo_Sel = 2
				&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = "WWP_TSUnChecked"
		EndCase
	EndIf
	If not (&TFProductoClaveExterna.IsEmpty() AND &TFProductoClaveExterna_To.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Clave Externa")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Number = &TFProductoClaveExterna
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, false, &CellRow, &FirstColumn + 2, "WWP_TSTo")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 3).Number = &TFProductoClaveExterna_To
	EndIf
	If not (&TFProductNumber_Sel.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Producto SAE")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFProductNumber_Sel)
	Else
		If not (&TFProductNumber.IsEmpty())
			WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Producto SAE")
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFProductNumber)
		EndIf
	EndIf
	&CellRow += 2

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'WriteColumnTitles'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&VisibleColumnCount = 0
	If &Session.Get(!'Produccion.listarProductosColumnsSelector') <> ''
		&ColumnsSelectorXML = &Session.Get(!'Produccion.listarProductosColumnsSelector')
		&ColumnsSelector.FromXml(&ColumnsSelectorXML)
	Else
		Do 'InitializeColumnsSelector'
	EndIf

	&ColumnsSelector.Columns.Sort(!'Order')
	For &ColumnsSelector_Column in &ColumnsSelector.Columns
		If &ColumnsSelector_Column.IsVisible = True
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = GetMessageText(iif(&ColumnsSelector_Column.DisplayName.IsEmpty(), &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName, &ColumnsSelector_Column.DisplayName))
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Bold = True
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Color = 11
			&VisibleColumnCount += 1
		EndIf
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'WriteData'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	For each DB.Producto
		order ProductoNombre  when &OrderedBy = 1 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ProductoNombre)  when &OrderedBy = 1 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ProductoCategoriaNombre  when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ProductoCategoriaNombre)  when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ProductoBaseProductoClave  when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ProductoBaseProductoClave)  when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ProductoClave  when &OrderedBy = 4 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ProductoClave)  when &OrderedBy = 4 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ProductoDescripcion  when &OrderedBy = 5 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ProductoDescripcion)  when &OrderedBy = 5 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ProductoPrecioUnitario  when &OrderedBy = 6 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ProductoPrecioUnitario)  when &OrderedBy = 6 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ProductoInventarioActual  when &OrderedBy = 7 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ProductoInventarioActual)  when &OrderedBy = 7 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ProductoTipoMaterial  when &OrderedBy = 8 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ProductoTipoMaterial)  when &OrderedBy = 8 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ProductoActivo  when &OrderedBy = 9 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ProductoActivo)  when &OrderedBy = 9 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ProductoClaveExterna  when &OrderedBy = 10 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ProductoClaveExterna)  when &OrderedBy = 10 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ProductNumber  when &OrderedBy = 11 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ProductNumber)  when &OrderedBy = 11 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		
		using listarProductosDS(&FilterFullText, &TFProductoCategoriaNombre, &TFProductoCategoriaNombre_Sel, &TFProductoBaseProductoClave, &TFProductoBaseProductoClave_Sel, &TFProductoClave
					, &TFProductoClave_Sel, &TFProductoNombre, &TFProductoNombre_Sel, &TFProductoDescripcion, &TFProductoDescripcion_Sel, &TFProductoPrecioUnitario
					, &TFProductoPrecioUnitario_To, &TFProductoInventarioActual, &TFProductoInventarioActual_To, &TFProductoTipoMaterial_Sels, &TFProductoActivo_Sel, &TFProductoClaveExterna
					, &TFProductoClaveExterna_To, &TFProductNumber, &TFProductNumber_Sel)

		// Write cell values
		&CellRow += 1
		
		Do 'BeforeWriteLine'
		&VisibleColumnCount = 0
		For &ColumnsSelector_Column in &ColumnsSelector.Columns
			If &ColumnsSelector_Column.IsVisible = True
				Do Case
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'ProductoCategoriaNombre'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(ProductoCategoriaNombre)
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'ProductoBaseProductoClave'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(ProductoBaseProductoClave)
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'ProductoClave'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(ProductoClave)
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'ProductoNombre'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(ProductoNombre)
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'ProductoDescripcion'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(ProductoDescripcion)
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'ProductoPrecioUnitario'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Number = ProductoPrecioUnitario
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'ProductoInventarioActual'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Number = ProductoInventarioActual
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'ProductoTipoMaterial'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = ProductoTipoMaterial.EnumerationDescription()
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'ProductoActivo'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = ProductoActivo.ToString()
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'ProductoClaveExterna'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Number = ProductoClaveExterna
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'ProductoImagen'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = ''
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'ProductNumber'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(ProductNumber)
				EndCase
				&VisibleColumnCount += 1
			EndIf
		EndFor		
		
		Do 'AfterWriteLine'

	Endfor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'CloseDocument'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&ExcelDocument.Save()
	Do 'CheckStatus'
	&ExcelDocument.Close()

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'CheckStatus'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	If (&ExcelDocument.ErrCode <> 0)
		&Filename = ""
		&ErrorMessage = &ExcelDocument.ErrDescription
		&ExcelDocument.Close()
		Return
	EndIf

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'InitializeColumnsSelector'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&ColumnsSelector = new WWPColumnsSelector()
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"ProductoCategoriaNombre", '', !'Categoría', True, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"ProductoBaseProductoClave", '', !'Producto Base', True, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"ProductoClave", '', !'Clave', True, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"ProductoNombre", '', !'Nombre', True, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"ProductoDescripcion", '', !'Descripcion', True, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"ProductoPrecioUnitario", '', !'Precio Unitario', True, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"ProductoInventarioActual", '', !'Inventario Actual', False, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"ProductoTipoMaterial", '', !'Tipo Material', True, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"ProductoActivo", '', !'Activo', True, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"ProductoClaveExterna", '', !'Clave Externa', False, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"ProductoImagen", '', !'Imagen', False, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"ProductNumber", '', !'Producto SAE', True, '')
		
	&UserCustomValue = LoadColumnsSelectorState.Udp(!'Produccion.listarProductosColumnsSelector')
	If not(&UserCustomValue.IsEmpty())
		&ColumnsSelectorAux.FromXml(&UserCustomValue)
		WWP_ColumnSelector_UpdateColumns(&ColumnsSelectorAux, &ColumnsSelector)
	EndIf

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'LoadGridState'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	// Load grid state from session.
	If &Session.Get(!"Produccion.listarProductosGridState") = !""
		&GridState.FromXml(LoadGridState.Udp(!"Produccion.listarProductosGridState"))
	Else
		&GridState.FromXml(&Session.Get(!"Produccion.listarProductosGridState"))
	Endif	

	&OrderedBy = &GridState.OrderedBy
	&OrderedDsc = &GridState.OrderedDsc

	For &GridStateFilterValue in &GridState.FilterValues
		Do Case
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"FILTERFULLTEXT"
				&FilterFullText.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRODUCTOCATEGORIANOMBRE"
				&TFProductoCategoriaNombre.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRODUCTOCATEGORIANOMBRE_SEL"
				&TFProductoCategoriaNombre_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRODUCTOBASEPRODUCTOCLAVE"
				&TFProductoBaseProductoClave.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRODUCTOBASEPRODUCTOCLAVE_SEL"
				&TFProductoBaseProductoClave_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRODUCTOCLAVE"
				&TFProductoClave.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRODUCTOCLAVE_SEL"
				&TFProductoClave_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRODUCTONOMBRE"
				&TFProductoNombre.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRODUCTONOMBRE_SEL"
				&TFProductoNombre_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRODUCTODESCRIPCION"
				&TFProductoDescripcion.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRODUCTODESCRIPCION_SEL"
				&TFProductoDescripcion_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRODUCTOPRECIOUNITARIO"
				&TFProductoPrecioUnitario.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFProductoPrecioUnitario_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRODUCTOINVENTARIOACTUAL"
				&TFProductoInventarioActual.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFProductoInventarioActual_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRODUCTOTIPOMATERIAL_SEL"
				&TFProductoTipoMaterial_SelsJson = &GridStateFilterValue.Value
				&TFProductoTipoMaterial_Sels.FromJson(&TFProductoTipoMaterial_SelsJson)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRODUCTOACTIVO_SEL"
				&TFProductoActivo_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRODUCTOCLAVEEXTERNA"
				&TFProductoClaveExterna.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFProductoClaveExterna_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRODUCTNUMBER"
				&TFProductNumber.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRODUCTNUMBER_SEL"
				&TFProductNumber_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
		EndCase
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'BeforeWriteLine'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */



	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'AfterWriteLine'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */



	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'WriteData'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	For each DB.Producto
		order ProductoNombre  when &OrderedBy = 1 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ProductoNombre)  when &OrderedBy = 1 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ProductoCategoriaNombre  when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ProductoCategoriaNombre)  when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ProductoBaseProductoClave  when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ProductoBaseProductoClave)  when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ProductoClave  when &OrderedBy = 4 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ProductoClave)  when &OrderedBy = 4 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ProductoDescripcion  when &OrderedBy = 5 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ProductoDescripcion)  when &OrderedBy = 5 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ProductoPrecioUnitario  when &OrderedBy = 6 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ProductoPrecioUnitario)  when &OrderedBy = 6 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ProductoInventarioActual  when &OrderedBy = 7 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ProductoInventarioActual)  when &OrderedBy = 7 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ProductoTipoMaterial  when &OrderedBy = 8 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ProductoTipoMaterial)  when &OrderedBy = 8 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ProductoActivo  when &OrderedBy = 9 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ProductoActivo)  when &OrderedBy = 9 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ProductoClaveExterna  when &OrderedBy = 10 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ProductoClaveExterna)  when &OrderedBy = 10 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ProductNumber  when &OrderedBy = 11 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ProductNumber)  when &OrderedBy = 11 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		
		using listarProductosDS(&FilterFullText, &TFProductoCategoriaNombre, &TFProductoCategoriaNombre_Sel, &TFProductoBaseProductoClave, &TFProductoBaseProductoClave_Sel, &TFProductoClave
					, &TFProductoClave_Sel, &TFProductoNombre, &TFProductoNombre_Sel, &TFProductoDescripcion, &TFProductoDescripcion_Sel, &TFProductoPrecioUnitario
					, &TFProductoPrecioUnitario_To, &TFProductoInventarioActual, &TFProductoInventarioActual_To, &TFProductoTipoMaterial_Sels, &TFProductoActivo_Sel, &TFProductoClaveExterna
					, &TFProductoClaveExterna_To, &TFProductNumber, &TFProductNumber_Sel)

		// Write cell values
		&CellRow += 1
		
		Do 'BeforeWriteLine'
		&VisibleColumnCount = 0
		For &ColumnsSelector_Column in &ColumnsSelector.Columns
			If &ColumnsSelector_Column.IsVisible = True
				Do Case
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'ProductoCategoriaNombre'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(ProductoCategoriaNombre)
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'ProductoBaseProductoClave'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(ProductoBaseProductoClave)
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'ProductoClave'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(ProductoClave)
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'ProductoNombre'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(ProductoNombre)
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'ProductoDescripcion'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(ProductoDescripcion)
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'ProductoPrecioUnitario'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Number = ProductoPrecioUnitario
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'ProductoInventarioActual'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Number = ProductoInventarioActual
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'ProductoTipoMaterial'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = ProductoTipoMaterial.EnumerationDescription()
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'ProductoActivo'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = ProductoActivo.ToString()
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'ProductoClaveExterna'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Number = ProductoClaveExterna
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'ProductoImagen'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = ''
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'ProductNumber'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(ProductNumber)
				EndCase
				&VisibleColumnCount += 1
			EndIf
		EndFor		
		
		Do 'AfterWriteLine'

	Endfor
